objective: Milestone 4 (part A): the exploration challenge (three energy cells, counter, guidance, beacon celebration, completion actions) and versioned local progress with Restart and safe in-memory fallback. Touch controls are built in parallel by a mobile-dev stage.

projectContext.query: 3D playable game avatar locomotion animation canvas hero transition talking avatar gestures projects skills contact

acceptanceCriteria: Challenge: one energy cell near each destination, each reachable on foot and visible from its approach, each collectible once (collecting twice counts once), an accessible HUD counter 'Energy cells n/3' with a polite live-region announcement, guidance back to the plaza after the third (a visible cue plus text), and interacting with the beacon only after all three triggers a short lighting effect and a celebration (the existing celebration-style gesture or clip on the avatar, no new external asset unless recorded in ASSETS.md) followed by a completion panel with Explore more, View projects and Contact actions; challenge.test.ts covers uniqueness, beacon gating, completion and restart.

Progress: progress is saved locally in a versioned format; reload restores collected cells and completion; Restart in the pause menu clears challenge progress but keeps settings; corrupt JSON, wrong types, an unknown version and a throwing storage getter fall back safely (in-memory when storage is unavailable, with no error to the visitor); progress.test.ts covers each case; in the browser with storage blocked the loop still completes.

The full loop (Play, collect three cells, beacon celebration, completion panel, Restart, reload persistence, Exit) is completed in the browser on the real GPU at 1440x900 with the keyboard, with one screenshot each of a cell, the counter, the guidance, the celebration and the completion panel.

Short regression on the production build: the round-2 camera wall sweep at the tower passage, entry warm Play with no hero freeze over 50 ms, Exit with focus on Play, and rAF p95 under 17.5 ms walking the campus at 1440x900; the / route First Load JS within 2 kB of 125 kB.

npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm test and npm run build exit 0 with exit codes explicitly captured (build in a copy of the tree), only content from data/index.ts and lib/persona.ts is shown, new content has no em dash or machine-local path, and no commit is made.
constraints: Work only inside the isolated worktree path supplied in the delegation prompt; do not commit; never run git stash, reset or checkout.

Do not edit data/index.ts, lib/persona.ts, components/avatar/* or any design section 9 do-not-touch file; do not change existing layout positions or interactables except adding cells and wiring the beacon.

Every browser you launch must use a --user-data-dir inside your stage output directory that you delete on exit and failure; check free disk and stop under 5 GB; stop every server by exact PID; delete build copies; never write evidence under the repository or .company.
Copy every acceptanceCriteria string verbatim into the report criteria array.

A mobile-dev stage runs in parallel in the same worktree and owns components/game/ui/TouchControls.tsx, its test and input.ts touch handling; coordinate through the existing input API and do not edit those files.
Save tokens: reuse existing harness scripts, keep logs on disk and read only tails, take only the screenshots the criteria name.
